programs.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation
programs.desc: An empty-nester father wants a beachfront home close to his boat on the Connecticut coastline; the construction crew consists of him and his three college age daughters.

programs.title: Barnwood Builders
programs.desc: The Builders give a modern mansion a complete log cabin makeover complete with log skins and a stacked log entryway; the home will be the centerpiece for a log cabin community; Mark tours a restored and redesigned pioneer cabin.

programs.title: Barnwood Builders
programs.desc: The Barnwood Builders fight through mud and heat to turn the salvaged Shaver House into a two-story lake house in Alabama; Mark experiments with new construction products; everyone ends up in the lake.

programs.title: Barnwood Builders
programs.sub_title: Saving Every Board From a Kincheloe Cattle Barn
programs.desc: In Jane Lew, W. Va., Mark and the guys salvage the wood from a 120-year-old cattle barn that is slated for demolition; the site is so wet they have to build their own road just to get to the barn.

programs.title: Barnwood Builders
programs.sub_title: Salvaging Pristine Hand-Hewn Logs From a West Virginia Cabin
programs.desc: In West Virginia, Mark and the guys salvage rare 170-year-old logs from a perfectly preserved log home; the pressure is on to keep these logs pristine as they take them down.

programs.title: Barnwood Builders
programs.sub_title: Building a New Log Home for the Boy Scouts
programs.desc: Mark and the guys volunteer to help a boy scout troop build a new lodge out of their old lodge while teaching them about the pioneer life.
